# ProvaDent

> ProvaDent is a Oral Health & Dental Wellness Supplement. ProvaDent is a daily oral wellness supplement marketed through its official website as a simple way to support healthy teeth, gums and overall mouth freshness. Rather than replacing brushing and flossing, it is positioned as an add-on to your existing routine — a capsule-style formula intended to be taken once a day alongside normal dental care. The official site is the place to review the full ingredient list, package pricing and current promotional offers before ordering.
